title: Fact envelope
description: The core envelope every fact has: one observation of a claim. See docs/design.md, Knowledge model and schema evolution, and docs/adr/0091-claims-and-observations.md.

id.description: Content-derived observation ID: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the canonical JSON of subject, predicate, object, attributes, lineage (when not empty), origin and evidence.

claim.description: The ID of the claim this is an observation of: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the canonical JSON of subject, predicate, object and the type's key attributes. Present on every fact read from the store.

predicate.description: Relationship or attribute type, e.g. CONSUMES or owner.

attributes.description: Further attributes, validated against the vocabulary's definition for the predicate.

lineage.description: The claim IDs the fact was derived from, in order. Absent when empty.

entityId.description: Stable entity ID <type>:<key>, e.g. service:orders or java:com.acme.Foo. The key is everything after the first colon.

object.description: An entity ID or a typed value, in canonical form.

value.description: Plain decimal text without trailing zeros, e.g. 1.5; zero is 0.

name.description: The extractor, model, user or rule that produced the fact.

version.description: Extractor, prompt or rule version, when there is one.

evidence.description: Where the fact was observed: one or more locations, the first being the one it is declared in. Evidence names no commit; a snapshot's repo@commit pairs give it.

path.description: File path relative to the repository root. Absent for a repository-wide fact.

blob.description: The git blob SHA (lowercase hex) of the file.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the file content, kept only for a file git does not hold, which has no blob.

role.description: What the location shows of the fact: where it is declared, where a value it holds is written, config its value was resolved against, or a place it cites.

not.description: A file with a blob keeps no content hash.

validity.description: Snapshot range in which the fact holds: from inclusive, to exclusive, no to while it still holds.
